g.text: Blue: five session medians and their min-max range. Orange: five session p95 and their min-max range.
These are observed ranges, not confidence intervals. Each p95 is nearest-rank of 30 measured passes in that session.
Source: stage_delivery_data.json. Readback/CPU checks and input preparation excluded from GPU timestamps.
